resources.string: Lets Lean Cleaner clear the cache of all your apps with one tap. When you start a cleaning run, it opens each app\'s Storage page in Settings and presses \"Clear cache\" for you. It is only active during a run you start, only acts on the Settings app, never touches app data or anything else, and nothing leaves your phone (the app has no internet access).
Lean Cleaner is pressing \"Clear cache\" in Settings for you. Please don\'t touch the screen.
